commentary_segments.text: The most important rule for good matching is to increase the size. Let us first have a look at how size plays for resistors and capacitors. For MOSTs we know already that spreading on V (and the T other parameters) is inversely proportional to the square root of WL. In other words, if both the channel width W and the channel length L are multiplied by 2, then the spreading (delta, sigma) is divided by 2. We will see that this also applies to resistors but not to capacitors.
